title: Agent Hive Project Agent Overrides
description: Project-local model and variant overrides for matching built-in and effective custom-agent declarations. All other Agent Hive settings remain global.

$schema.description: Schema reference for this project override file.

agents.description: Model and variant overrides for matching built-in agents present in the effective global/default config. Unknown names are ignored.

customAgents.description: Model and variant overrides for matching custom-agent declarations in the effective global/default config. Unknown names are ignored and never create agents.

model.description: Model identifier override, such as provider/model-id.
